name: Fiona and Ruaridh

intro.text: FIONA: Strip the Willow starts at seven, and it starts with you.
RUARIDH: We'll teach you the steps. We'll also teach you humility. That one costs extra.

win: FIONA: Ye've the legs for it! RUARIDH: And the feet! We'll call that a draw. Mostly in our favour.
after: Every step has a caller, and every caller has a favourite couple. We're the couple.
